content.value: A de series motor , connected to a 440V supply, runs at 600 rpm when taking a current of SOA. Calculate the value of resistance of which when inserted in series with the motor will reduce the speed to 400 rpm, the gross torque being then half its previous value. The resistance of the motor is 0.2 fl. Assume flux is proportional to field current.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
